description: A shell script containing a set of tests for Git diff functionalities, utilizing test-lib.sh. It tests diff behaviors with unmerged index entries, file modifications, and output formats.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given command sequence.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specified code.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual files, asserting they are identical.
